Add a commanding deeply recessed arched gate, wide short stone approach stairs and chunky stone buttresses. Make the overall mass wider and more monumental than the source, with clear stepped silhouette and three tiers. Keep violet roofs and restrained matte gold trim. Replace the enormous toy crown on top with a smaller integrated crown-shaped golden parapet; retain a simple crown relief over the entrance. Architectural mass and height should create power, rather than more jewelry or dozens of tiny turrets. Few large windows, no fussy detail.
